disposition: Retained interleaved certified forward transform plus quantization; preliminary serial-accumulator version had no useful gain.
scope: One original 513x259 RGBA8 encode case, frozen owned quality 69/native qscale 5 and 4:4:4 sampling. One preliminary screen, one improved screen, one 12-sample confirmation. No new image, quality preparation/enumeration or CPU profile.

rejectedSerialAccumulators.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent JPEG bytes: explicit single-round alpha flattening on 0x204060, full-range BT.601 conversion, 4:4:4 encode, output acquisition/release. Native codec/conversion/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused, but pixels are flattened/converted and encoded every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray. Native optimal Huffman and managed fixed Huffman recorded. Quality matched by frozen <=0.25 dB RGB source-error band; fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.

primitive: Two eight-term separable passes with independent row/frequency accumulators; frozen owned basis, separate products/additions. A 2^-30 margin certifies the original quantized integer, otherwise original direct y/x evaluation. Reuse 512 stack bytes, preserve existing coefficient-array allocation, original 4096-unit atomic charge, all encoded bytes and standalone coefficient bits.

diagnostic.jitScope: Dedicated VM only, actual preliminary timed DLL. Serial vector accumulation and cold fallback spills observed; no local timing or new CPU profile.

fixedCountAllocationComparison.recovery: Original examples and timed-DLL IL checks passed. First allocation invocation omitted required DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT=1. Correct invocation produced identical 16-operation totals and histograms, with a different ordering of the same five 248-byte extras. The original overstrict sequence assertion failed; raw arrays are retained and no allocation invocation is repeated. Extra allocation ownership is not attributed.

limitations: Retained mean ratios 1.94915x and 1.95494x; confirmation conservative upper 1.97432x. Short-screen conservative upper remains 2.17844x; independent passing confirmation remains open.
Both statistical prequiet checks pass and postquiet checks fail. Original failures and cooldown samples are retained; this is not a passing quietness certificate.

The initial package job completed all examples and statistical DLL IL checks before an allocation helper failed because its required one-processor environment was omitted. A recovery invocation supplies that environment, then an overstrict per-operation sequence assertion fails. Identical 16-operation totals and allocation histograms are accepted from the preserved raw output without repeating it; five equal 248-byte extras have a different order, with no ownership attribution.
Unsupported CPUs retain original forward/quantization behavior and have no new performance measurement. Other images, depths and sampling directions remain unmeasured here.
Unknown, unmatched, uncovered and unconfirmed required paths remain open. PNG16 decode is the largest retained measured point gap near 2.00928x.
